capabilities: Render a branching timeline canvas with flows, statuses and filters
Create, switch and archive versions of story notes, grouped into version sets
Define custom time systems, entity types and universe laws in frontmatter
Map relations between entities and run an advisory consistency report
Export selected notes as Markdown, HTML book, HTML wiki or PDF
extras: The README warns the frontmatter schema may still shift before version 1.0. Data (time system, type registry) is kept in vault notes so the vault stays readable without the plugin. Includes a built-in guide with an example story that can be removed afterwards.
motivation: The README's 'Why' section says worldbuilding notes are rarely written in order and most tooling assumes you write forwards and never change your mind, while this plugin assumes unfinished is a normal state.
problem: Obsidian notes carry no structure for fiction worldbuilding, where writing happens out of order, drafts fork into alternatives, and changing the past means revising many linked notes at once.
summary: Worldbuilding toolkit that lays out branching timelines on a canvas, manages versioned story drafts, custom time systems, entity types, relations and consistency checks.
